description: This file defines the ConditionalStyles class responsible for handling and applying conditional formatting styles within an XLSX spreadsheet using the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for loading conditional styles from XML, external styles, and applying them to worksheet cells.

classes.name: ConditionalStyles
classes.description: A class responsible for interpreting, managing, and applying conditional formatting styles within an XLSX worksheet as part of PhpSpreadsheet's XLSX reader.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ConditionalStyles object with worksheet, XML, and optional styles.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads conditional styles from the worksheet XML and applies them.

methods.name: loadFromExt
methods.description: Loads external conditional styles using a StyleReader.

methods.name: setConditionalsFromExt
methods.description: Sets conditional styles on worksheet cells from external data.

methods.name: readConditionalsFromExt
methods.description: Parses external XML to extract conditional formatting rules.

methods.name: readConditionalRuleFromExt
methods.description: Creates a Conditional object from external XML rule data.

methods.name: readStyleFromExt
methods.description: Reads style elements from external XML and constructs a Style object.

methods.name: readConditionalStyles
methods.description: Extracts conditional formatting rules from worksheet XML.

methods.name: setConditionalStyles
methods.description: Applies conditional styles to specified worksheet ranges.

methods.name: readStyleRules
methods.description: Converts CFRules XML into Conditional objects.

methods.name: readDataBarOfConditionalRule
methods.description: Extracts data bar formatting from a CFRule XML element.

methods.name: readDataBarExtLstOfConditionalRule
methods.description: Reads extension list data for data bar conditional formatting.
